about: AFFORDANCE & CONTACT swarm. Per set-piece part: interaction geometry in the piece's own pixels (x right, y down, origin = top-left of the part .webp). Kinds: seat {seat_y, x_range, back: left|right|behind|none}, surface {surface_y, rest_y, x_range, top_face?}, grip {point, up (unit vector, image coords), mode}, aperture {role: frame|painted_opening|leaf, openings: [{rect [x,y,w,h], type door|window|floor_opening, floor_y, sill_y?, passable}]} or leaf {rect, hinge_side}, lean {edges [{side, x, y_range}], face?} or {edge: top, y, x_range}, occluder {hide_y, solid_y, x_range, base_y, coverage_below, hides: solid|partial|see-through}, stand_on {top_y, foot_y, x_range, ground?, walk_band?}. Every affordance carries confidence (inferred) and evidence (label words: measured; clip_p_kind: measured; geometry rule + numbers: measured). parts = has affordances; checked_none = every other set-piece card, with the reason; skipped = reference panels. ALL set-piece sheets processed, no sampling.
